```text
# PR #2335: Patch: a few named durations and easing curves for every motion on the board

Closes #2110

## What changed

The board now moves on one motion vocabulary. New `apps/web/src/motion.css` names four durations (`--motion-instant` 80ms, `--motion-fast` 150ms, `--motion-base` 250ms, `--motion-slow` 400ms — fast/base/slow reuse BUILD M5-T4's own figures) and five easing curves (`--ease-standard`, `--ease-out`, `--ease-in`, `--ease-in-out`, `--ease-overshoot`), imported by `index.css` directly after `surfaces.css`.

Every board stylesheet's transitions and animations moved onto it: `index.css` (3 transitions), `game/animations.css` (curves only — no duration or delay touched, verified in the diff), `game/board.css`, `game/clock.css`, `game/craft/craft.css`, `game/drag/blocked.css`, `game/drag/drag.css`, `game/inspectable.css`, `game/notices.css`, `game/prompt.css`, `game/reveal.css` (curves and durations), plus `game/showcase/showcase.css`, `game/activate.css`, `game/aim/opponentAim.css`, `game/highlights.css`, `game/market.css`, `game/spent.css` (curves). Every `* var(--anim-scale…)` factor was kept. The `jk-lunge` keyframe stops spell their new curve values out literally, since a keyframe stop cannot read a `var()`.

New guard `apps/web/src/motion.test.ts` (7 tests) proves the token list and import order, that every transition/animation names a curve/`linear`/`steps()`, that every UI duration is a token/BUILD's/fed-in/`KEEP`, that `animations.css` takes no duration token, and that reduced motion still zeroes everything with no lost `--anim-scale`. `Hand.test.tsx` expects the tokenized flip duration; README gains the motion paragraph. No ruling added, no patch fragment (catalog untouched), per the plan.

## How it was tested

- `vitest run src/motion.test.ts` — 7/7 pass.
- The plan's related set (motion, surfaces, palette, typescale, typography, fx/css, animations, Hand, Clock, reveal, countered, position-switch, keyword-loss) — 13 files, 196/196 pass, including the `animations.test.ts` durations block and the `fx/css.test.ts` duration-literal test.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` — clean (an early run failed only on the generated Luau bindings while `build-wasm.sh` was still running; clean on re-run after they landed).
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check` (1471 rulings, 3328 proofs — ok).

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- Skipped loading the taste skill: every value is dictated by the plan, so there was no design judgment for it to inform.
- Used `sed` for global exact-string swaps and the file editor where a string was ambiguous (the two identical `--ease-in` lines, disambiguated by surrounding context); verified by occurrence counts plus the guard test.
- Ran the plan's 13-file test set instead of the full `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, per the harness rule against whole-suite runs; nothing outside those files was touched.

## Look twice

- Player-visible timing shifts are the task itself: hovers 120→150ms, presses 60→80ms, the R434 flip 560→400ms, plus slight curve changes. Rules, replays and hidden information are uninvolved (CSS only).
- The clock's four `200ms linear` transitions intentionally stay literal — they follow `TICK_MS` in `Clock.tsx`.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 1 of 3.

Notes the reviewer left (not blocking):

- `apps/web/src/game/handHints.css:20`: surfaces.test.ts fails on main with or without this change (handHints.css radius/z-index from #2306), so it is pre-existing, not caused by this diff.
```

````markdown
**Goal.** Give the board one motion vocabulary in `apps/web/src/motion.css`: four named durations and five named easing curves, imported by `index.css` after `surfaces.css`. Move every board stylesheet's transitions and animations onto it, as #2105, #2107 and #2109 did for the palette, the type scale and the surfaces. BUILD M5-T4's event durations stay exactly as they are and take only the curves. Reduced motion still zeroes every duration. `apps/web/src/motion.test.ts` proves all three, and it fails on today's sheets (I checked on a scratch copy).

**Files to touch**

| Path | | What |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/motion.css` | new | the tokens |
| `apps/web/src/motion.test.ts` | new | the guard |
| `apps/web/src/index.css` | change | a fifth `@import`; three transitions |
| `apps/web/src/game/animations.css` | change | curves only |
| `apps/web/src/game/board.css`, `game/clock.css`, `game/craft/craft.css`, `game/drag/blocked.css`, `game/drag/drag.css`, `game/inspectable.css`, `game/notices.css`, `game/prompt.css`, `game/reveal.css` | change | curves and durations |
| `apps/web/src/game/showcase/showcase.css`, `game/activate.css`, `game/aim/opponentAim.css`, `game/highlights.css`, `game/market.css`, `game/spent.css` | change | curves |
| `apps/web/src/game/Hand.test.tsx` | change | one expected string |
| `apps/web/README.md` | change | one paragraph |

Do not touch any duration or delay in `game/animations.css`, nor `game/table.css`, `game/deckbuilder/`, `game/facedown.css`, `game/countered.css`, `src/cards/`, `src/fx/`, any `.ts`/`.tsx` except the two tests, `crates/`, `spec/`, `BUILD.md` or `e2e/`. Governing: BUILD M5-T4 (its Duration column; "`prefers-reduced-motion` collapses every duration to 0"), R200 (Reduce motion setting), R434 (end-of-game flip), R701 (slam and impact effects). No ruling is added. No patch fragment is needed, because the catalog does not change (#2262 had none).

**Steps**

1. Create `apps/web/src/motion.css`:
```css
/* The board's motion vocabulary (#2110), checked by src/motion.test.ts (MOTION_DURATIONS,
   MOTION_CURVES). instant: a press, a pointer-following ghost; fast: a hover, a colour, a scrim;
   base: a lift, a tick, a deal; slow: a reveal, a settling pop, a toast leaving (fast, base and
   slow are BUILD M5-T4's own figures). standard: a change between two rests; out: arriving; in:
   leaving; in-out: back and forth; overshoot: a pop past its mark. A @keyframes stop cannot read
   a var(), so it spells a curve's value out. Reduce motion zeroes these like every duration. */

:root {
  --motion-instant: 80ms;
  --motion-fast: 150ms;
  --motion-base: 250ms;
  --motion-slow: 400ms;

  --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.7, 0.4, 1);
  --ease-in: cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.8, 0.7);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1);
  --ease-overshoot: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.25, 1.1);
}
````
